name: Knott's Ghost Town Grill Sourdough Bread Bowl Clam Chowder or Chicken Noodle Soup
brandOrRestaurant: Ghost Town Grill (Ghost Town · Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Warm sourdough bread bowl filled with comforting soup (or Chicken Noodle Soup in a bowl) gives you a gentle break from theme-park burgers—just avoid the spicy bean Chili Bread Bowl.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Chicken Noodle Soup with warm bread (or Clam Chowder in a Sourdough Bread Bowl with a lactase enzyme)—never order the Beef & Bean Chili bowl during flares.
watchOuts: Skip the Chili Bread Bowl (beans + chili powder); take lactase if choosing Clam Chowder
